title: 第九章 寇可往我亦可往第十章 修仙好啊这仙必须得修啊
slug: 看守废丹房三年我偷偷成仙了
lines: “今天的风儿，甚是喧嚣啊。”
暖阳初升，紫气东来，秦凡不禁沉醉地闭眼深吸了一口灵气。
在闭关一月之后，可算再次闻到了这股子灵山之间的清新。
这一个月，唯有炼丹弟子隔三差五的过来送废丹，他却始终不曾出去过。
怎一个刻苦了得。
牙都快特么累松了。
好在，功夫不负有心人，短短一个月，硬是凭借丹药的组合技，突破到了炼气十二层大圆满。
距筑基期只差一步，只可惜啊，天赋太辣鸡，菩提丹吃冒烟了也不管用。
要想顺利筑基，只能靠二品丹药筑基丹了。
可这么一来，问题就出现了，那就是秦凡如今没有筑基期妖兽的妖丹。
所以，他这次出门，不光要去坊市赴约，还要顺路买一些妖丹回来。
一枚筑基初期的妖丹差不多要两百下品灵石，相当于两颗菩提丹换一枚筑基初期的妖丹。
要想凑足筑基用的筑基丹，保守估计，他这个天赋得几十颗才行。
差不多得弄个五炉子，也就是需要五枚筑基初期的妖丹。
再换算过来，那便是十颗菩提丹。
还行，不算贵，菩提丹他现在还有个十来瓶，买妖丹肯定是够用了。
但这一次，他不打算摆摊了。
摆摊太显眼，还是直接去店铺里用丹药换妖丹比较稳妥。
虽说店铺要价比较狠，可毕竟小命更重要一些。
就算被人惦记上，也只可能是个把人，不可能是一群人。
“距离见面还有几个时辰，便先去换妖丹吧。”
废丹房这边，只要给孟祥辉送过好处，便不需要一直守着。
若有人来送废丹，直接进殿内一倒就行，反正每天送的丹药，大差不差，都是那些。
秦凡一眼便能认出来，也不需要特意去问。
只是刚要下山，忽地楞在了原地，只见前方不知何时，竟出现了两个头戴恶鬼面具的身影。
俩人双臂抱胸，一个劲的冷哼哼，拽的二五八万模样，没有像他似的刻意压制境界，都是炼气八层的修为。
却正是阳伟和张不举。
“俩外门弟子？”
“打扮成这样是啥意思？”
“唱大戏？”
秦凡一脸古怪望着两人。
“两位师兄，你们这是……”他疑惑开口。
“打劫。”
稍胖一些的阳伟冷声威胁道：“把身上的丹药都交出来，要不然，别怪咱们兄弟以大欺小。”
“打劫？”
content_en:
"The wind is very noisy today."
The warm sun was rising, and the purple energy was coming from the east. Qin Fan couldn't help but close his eyes and take a deep breath of spiritual energy intoxicatedly.
After a month of retreat, I could smell the freshness of Ziling Mountain again.
This month, only the alchemy disciples came here and there to deliver waste elixirs, but he never went out.
How can one be so hardworking?
My teeth are almost so tired.
Fortunately, hard work paid off. In just one month, he relied on the combination of pills to reach the twelfth level of Qi Refining.
It's only one step away from the foundation building stage, but it's a pity that the talent is too bad, and the Bodhi Pill won't work even if it smokes.
If you want to successfully build the foundation, you can only rely on the second-grade elixir, the Foundation Building Pill.
But then, a problem arises, that is, Qin Fan currently does not have the demon elixir for the foundation-building demon beast.
Therefore, when he went out this time, he not only went to Fangshi for an appointment, but also bought some demon pills on the way back.
A demon pill in the early stage of foundation building costs almost two hundred low-grade spiritual stones, which is equivalent to exchanging two Bodhi pills for one demon pill in the early stage of foundation building.
If he wanted to collect enough Foundation Establishment Pills for Foundation Establishment, it would be conservatively estimated that he would need dozens of pills for his talent.
It is almost necessary to get five furnaces, which means five demon pills from the early stage of foundation building are needed.
If calculated again, that would be ten Bodhi Pills.
It's okay, not expensive. He still has about ten bottles of Bodhi Pill, which is definitely enough to buy the Demon Pill.
But this time, he doesn't plan to set up a stall.
Setting up a stall is too conspicuous, so it would be safer to go directly to the store to exchange elixirs for demon elixirs.
Although the prices charged by the store are quite harsh, after all, life is more important.
Even if someone is interested, it can only be one person, not a group of people.
"There are still a few hours until we meet, so let's go change the demon pill first."
As long as Meng Xianghui has received benefits from the Waste Pill Room, there is no need to guard him all the time.
If someone comes to deliver useless elixirs, just go into the palace and pour them out. Anyway, the elixirs delivered every day are pretty much the same.
Qin Fan could recognize it at a glance, and there was no need to ask specifically.
Just as he was about to go down the mountain, he suddenly froze on the spot and saw two figures wearing evil ghost masks appearing in front of him.
The two of them crossed their arms and kept snorting coldly, dragging each other as if they were twenty-five or eighty thousand. They didn't deliberately suppress their realm like him. They were both at the eighth level of Qi refining.
But it was Yang Wei and Zhang Buju.
"Two outer disciples?"
"What do you mean by dressing up like this?"
"Sing a big show?"
Qin Fan looked at the two of them with a strange expression.
"Two senior brothers, what are you..." he said in confusion.
"Robbery."
Yang Wei, who was slightly fatter, threatened in a cold voice: "Hand over all the elixirs on your body, otherwise, don't blame us brothers for bullying the younger ones."
"Robbery?"
